text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"That was close... I know it's not a bad 
result, but still..."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
A-Ahaha... We were just one step short, 
weren't we?
choice_data_list: Still, I was able to give it my all!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, that's... that's right! There's 
no doubt I gave it my absolute best!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Still, coming short of 1st place is really 
frustrating after all—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"The trophy that got away weighs heavy." 
Next time, I'll do my best so I can 
rejoice from the bottom of my heart!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"You're right... I can't be satisfied with 
this placing."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"The scenery won't change unless you run." 
I'll train more and more, and make sure to 
take 1st place next time!
